description: How reliable Puerto Rico's grid has been over the years, from the performance data LUMA Energy and Genera PR file with the Puerto Rico Energy Bureau: SAIDI (average minutes without power a year) and SAIFI by fiscal year, the latest year by the 16 reliability districts LUMA reports to the Energy Bureau (not the 7 outage-map regions of get_power_status), and the latest monthly CAIDI. Filings are quarterly and revised; for outages right now use get_power_status. Cite 787daily.com/live/power/ and the Energy Bureau.
name: get_grid_reliability
title: Grid reliability filings
